title: Quiz Viewer Quiz Document
description: A quiz set produced by AGENTS/GENERATE_QUIZ.md and displayed by the quiz viewer (AGENTS/DEVELOP_QUIZ_VIEWER.md). See DOCS/API_QUIZ_VIEWER.md.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editors.

id.description: Stable identifier of the quiz set. Unique among the presets.

title.description: Title shown in the open dialog and the viewer header.

description.description: Short summary of what the quiz covers.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag of the quiz text.

difficulty.description: Difficulty of the whole set, per AGENTS/GENERATE_QUIZ.md.

authors.description: People or agents who produced the quiz.

sources.description: Slide decks and references the quiz was generated from.

questions.description: The N questions, in the order they are asked.

difficulty.description: easy: 쉬움, normal: 보통, hard: 어려움.

path.description: Workspace-relative path, e.g. typst/main.typ or resources/xxx.pdf.

page.description: Page or page range in a reference, e.g. "12" or "12-14".

id.description: Identifier of the choice, unique within its question.

text.description: The statement shown as the choice.

valid.description: Whether the statement is a valid (타당한) answer to the question. Not whether it is the answer to pick.

explanation.description: Why the statement is valid or why it is refuted.

id.description: Identifier of the question, unique within the quiz.

type.description: Multiple choice with exactly one correct pick.

mode.description: pick-valid (경우 1): one valid statement, the rest refuted; pick it. pick-invalid (경우 2): one refuted statement, the rest valid; pick it.

choices.description: Exactly four choices (4지선다). The viewer may shuffle them.

answer.description: id of the correct choice. Must be the only valid choice (pick-valid) or the only invalid one (pick-invalid).

explanation.description: Overall explanation of the correct answer, shown after answering.

difficulty.description: Overrides the set's difficulty for this question.
